children: Land & Armaments won a $230.1M contract modification on Wednesday to produce full-rate 32 Amphibious Combat Vehicle (ACV) recovery variants.
The contract covers associated production, fielding, support costs, and spares.

The work is expected to be completed by November 2028, while the total contract value could reach $4.1B if all options are exercised. The award is fully funded by FY2026 Marine Corps procurement funds.
Information and Electronic Systems Integration was awarded a $146.7M U.S. Air Force contract to produce 40 hardware sets for the F-15EX Lot 7/8 EPAWSS, including magazines and retainers.
The work is expected to be completed by August 2030, with $58.8M in FY2025 and FY2026 procurement funds obligated at the award.
Combined, the two awards are worth about $376.8M, expanding BAE Systems' work across both Marine Corps combat vehicles and Air Force F-15EX survivability systems.

title: BAE Systems wins $376.8M worth of new Marine, Air Force contracts
